decisions.reason: As a core airfield-lighting control product in the firm's established competence, it likely remains above strategic aspiration despite uncertain short-term sales and long airport procurement cycles.

Because it complements the surveillance portfolio and German industrial firms often tolerate some uncertainty in such system components, management is more likely to keep it unless peer comparisons show a clear shortfall.
The training program is a supporting service with modest resource demands, so organizational slack and its value for the installed base make discontinuation only moderately likely.
A narrowly scoped training course that was only lightly promoted is the easiest candidate for problemistic search and resource redeployment if its results fell below aspiration.
The collaboration software tool fits airport digitalization but is more peripheral and competitive than core equipment, so management would keep it only if performance is near aspiration.
The MLAT surveillance system is a strategic product with high sunk development costs and strong fit to the airport systems portfolio, which favors retention through an uncertain ramp-up.
